attempted_claim: Let {u_j} be an orthonormal Hecke basis of even Maass cusp forms for SL_2(Z), with spectral parameters t_j, and let phi be a fixed even Hecke-Maass cusp form. Prove that, in the harmonic/Watson normalization, for every epsilon > 0 and Delta >= T^(1/5+epsilon), sum_{T < t_j <= T + Delta} L(1/2, sym^2(u_j) tensor phi) <<_{phi,epsilon} Delta T^(1+epsilon). Equivalently, prove the corresponding sharp Delta T^(1+epsilon) upper bound for the short-window quantum variance sum of |<|u_j|^2, phi>|^2.
decisive_failure: No complete bound was proved: the Maass off-diagonal Airy transition at Delta=T^{1/5} remains unresolved, the threshold algebra is conditional on an unproved off-diagonal shape, and the barrier model is heuristic rather than a theorem. Artifacts support only the conductor count and the quantitative gap analysis.
